_provenance.note: Wyoming citation authorities. Wyoming's operative SNAP policy manual is the SNAP and POWER Policy Manual, cited by a numbered-section convention such as 'Section 502' (Categorically Eligible Persons) or 'Section 708' (ABAWD Requirements), grouped into hundreds-blocks (100s intake, 500s eligibility factors, 600s citizenship/fleeing-felon, 700s work requirements, 800s assets, 1100s income, 1200s certification). This pack defines a single citation family, 'wysec', matching this section-number convention, since Wyoming's manual (unlike Delaware's DSSM, which mixes 'DSSM 9042'-style numbers with a separate Register-of-Regulations citation family) uses one consistent numbering scheme throughout with no separate amendment-order citation family this pack found reason to track.

patterns.note: Wyoming DFS SNAP and POWER Policy Manual, cited with its own section number, e.g. Section 502 (Categorically Eligible Persons), Section 606 (Citizenship and Immigrant Status), Section 610 (Fleeing Felons/Probation or Parole Violator), Section 708 (ABAWD Requirements), Section 800 (Asset Limits), Section 1201 (Establishing a SNAP Certification Period).

wysec.note: Application/Intake Process — application timelines, Tribal TANF routing for enrolled Tribal members resident in Fremont or Hot Springs County
Client's Rights — includes the FDPIR/SNAP mutual-exclusion clause: households must choose one or the other and may not participate in both simultaneously
Categorically Eligible Persons — narrow SSI/POWER/Tribal-TANF-recipiency-based categorical eligibility only; NO 200% FPL BBCE gate exists in Wyoming's manual
Citizenship and Immigrant Status — current post-OBBBA (7/4/2025) noncitizen-eligibility table with embedded links to FNS implementation guidance

Fleeing Felons/Probation or Parole Violator — the ONLY criminal-justice SNAP disqualification category in Wyoming's manual; no drug-felony-conviction disqualification section exists anywhere in the 600 series
Exemptions From Work Registration — 12 categories, including age 60+, physical/mental unfitness, caretaker of a child under 6, drug/alcohol treatment program participant, bona fide student

ABAWD Requirements — current post-OBBBA age band (18 through 64 as of July 4, 2025), dependent-under-14 threshold, 36-month fixed period (current: 10/1/2024-9/30/2027), seven exemption categories including 'is a member of an Indian tribe'

Asset Limits — $3,000 (under 60, no disabled member) / $4,500 (60+ or disabled member present), matching the current federal FY2026 floor exactly; vehicle exemption for ALL licensed and unlicensed vehicles used for transportation

Establishing a SNAP Certification Period — caps ALL certification periods at 12 months (calendar-month basis), including all-elderly/disabled no-earned-income households (no extended 24-month track), effective 1/1/2016
